description: Approved responsive-regime Figure 2 campaign: strict two-pole resolution, bounded finite-pulse reversal, and deterministic pulse-train frequency response.

metadata.competition_protocol: two outer-20% cues at 2*alpha0, 80 s with 40-s cosine taper, 15% left/right asymmetry; 20,000-s common censoring horizon
metadata.frequency_protocol: after the same induction, ten alternating square half-cycles at 4*alpha0 over the outer 40%; full-cycle periods 100-1600 s
metadata.model_provenance: 2026 de Belly mechanochemical Rac-Rho-MCA model with the documented reflection-symmetric boundary extension

parameter_selection.basis: reviewed L=15 kymographs showing strong two-pole establishment and resolution, autonomous finite-pulse reversal, and a frequency cutoff

metadata.reversal_protocol: left induction 2*alpha0 outer 20% for 160 s; opposite right cue 4*alpha0 outer 40% from 600-920 s; response must begin by 1420 s and persist at least 1000 s
